senses.gloss: pr. n. (Πευσαρος?) Peusarus (?), name of a tortuous street, prob. in Tiberias.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1:31">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ</cite> top <he>דרך … כגון אהן פ׳</he> (ed. Lehm. <he>פווסרס</he>, ed. Krot. <cite ref="Q00310"><he>פופסדס</he></cite>) it was a tortuous road (where he met her, v. <cite ref="P01199"><he>עַקְמוּמִית</he></cite>), like the P.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:6:6">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40ᵃ</cite> bot. <cite ref="Q01238"><he>פסוורוס</he></cite>.
Y. Erub. VIII, 25ᵇ top אהן פיו׳ זרק מתוכה וכ׳ if one throws an object (on the Sabbath) from the P. into an open public road or vice versa, v. פָּלַשׁ I.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 7:2:12">Y. Shek. VII, 50ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>נשכח מן פיוסרוס ולגיו</he> (not <he>דלגיו</he>; Bab. ed. <cite ref="Q00603"><he>פיוסא</he></cite>, Ms. M. <he>פווסרס</he>) I wish I might find it somewhere towards the interior of the P.
